title: Annotatio V §.V close: Pestilent charity without Truth; cursed Unio that does not love Jesus in Truth — stop before §.VI
pass_a_gloss: Pestilent is Charity without Truth, and cursed is every Ecclesiastical Union that does not love Jesus in Truth: 1 John 4:10–12ff., page m. 39. Compare our German tract: Short Sketch of the Unity of the Evangelical-Lutheran and Reformed. §. 4, from page 21 to 25.
pass_b_english: Charity without Truth is pestilent, and every church union that does not love Jesus in Truth is cursed (1 John 4:10–12ff., p. m. 39).
Compare our German tract: Short Sketch of the Unity of the Evangelical-Lutheran and Reformed, §. 4, pages 21–25.
Stop before §. VI (limits of Consociation considered formally — Tolerance vs perfect Union).
source_text: Pestilens Charitas est absque Veritate, & maledicta omnis Ecclesiastica Unio, quae Jesum non amat in Veritate: 1.Joh. IV. 10. 11. 12.seq. pag. m. 39. Confer Tractatulum nost. Germanicum: Kurzer Entwurff der Einigkeit der Evangelisch-Lutherischen und Reformirten. §. 4. à pag. 21. ad 25.
notes: Pestilens Charitas; 1 John; German Einigkeit tract; stop before §.VI.
